material_hint: Which material the meshes on this bone are drawn with. A new one starts out like the old and is changed under Materials.
material_authored: Empty keeps the material as the model made it.
effect_node_gone: This node is no longer in the effect.
name: Name
unknown_attachment: This comes from an addon that is not loaded. It is kept as it is and does nothing.
no_attachment_editor: This kind of attachment cannot be shown here.
start_physics: Drop the rig and see what it does
model_hint: What hangs here sits in model space and follows no bone: a collider for the whole body, a button on a panel.
generate_colliders: Fit a collider around every bone that holds geometry
collider.name: Name
collider.name.hint: What scripts and events call this collider. Unique within the rig.
collider.alignment.hint: Oriented turns with the bone and the entity. World-aligned stays square to the world and only follows where the bone is: cheaper, and it ignores the rotation.
collider.rotation.hint: Degrees, applied X, then Y, then Z. A world-aligned collider ignores it.
collider.shape.hint: What inside the box is solid. The physics addon adds spheres, capsules, cylinders and hulls.
collider.modes.hit.hint: Melee attacks and projectiles land here instead of on the entity's box. The damage source tells which collider was hit.
collider.modes.interact.hint: A right click on it reaches scripts with the collider's name, like a button on a panel.
collider.modes.contact.hint: What it does to a body that walks into it. Push shoves it aside the way mobs shove each other, Solid stops it and can be stood on, and carries what stands on it as it moves. Moving with an animation, both pass their speed on.
collider.modes.force.hint: How much of its own speed a moving collider passes on to what it runs into. 1 sends it off as fast as the collider moves; 0 only pushes it out.
ik.target_name.hint: The name IK chains pick this target by. Unique across the rig.
ik.rotation.hint: Degrees, X, then Y, then Z. Matters to chains that turn their end as the target is turned.
ik.bones.hint: How many bones above this one bend so it reaches. 2 for an arm or a leg.
ik.target.hint: The target the bone reaches for. Without one the bone stays where the animation put it, which is what Ground works on.
ik.pole.hint: The target the chain bends toward: where the knee or elbow points. Without one the chain bends as the animation bends it.
ik.ground.hint: Lowers or raises the goal onto the ground under it, keeping the height above the entity's feet the animation gave it. This is what puts a foot on a step. The preview has no ground, so it does nothing there.
ik.weight.hint: From 0 to 1, how much the chain overrides the animation. An animator expression, such as d.holding_cup.
ik.stretch.hint: How many times its length the chain may stretch when the target is further away. 1 does not stretch. The bones' geometry stretches with them.
ik.end.hint: How the bone at the end is turned once the chain has bent.
